title: Audit repro scripts and docs in the 2026-10-28 audit package are portable and clean up after themselves
acceptance: repro/d1-tooling-deploy-badsha.sh resolves its worktree argument to an absolute path before changing directory, so a relative path works.
repro/d1-tooling-deploy-selfcheck-mutation.sh removes scripts/deploy.sh.mut and its temp dir on any exit (trap), so an interrupted run leaves the worktree clean.
repro/lead-cm02-unbound-eme-chromium.cjs uses an ephemeral port and closes the browser and server in a finally block.

The audit package's lane briefs, lane files, verification.md and e2e-env-patch.diff use repo-relative or placeholder paths instead of /home/user, /tmp/claude-0 and /opt/pw-browsers container paths, per AGENTS.md's portability rule.

evidence.summary: Final review of #644 on a32bdd7: four non-significant findings in archived repro scripts and docs (relative-path cp, no cleanup trap, fixed port, hardcoded container paths). Logged 2026-10-28 under the significance rule.
Rerun 2026-11-26 in a disposable worktree at 4c344e2, passing the worktree as a relative path: same output as evidence/d1-tooling-deploy-badsha.txt (deploy.sh exit=128) and no temp dir left behind.

Rerun 2026-11-26 in a disposable worktree at 4c344e2: baseline, M1, M2 and M3 still print 'self-check passed'. A second run killed with SIGTERM while scripts/deploy.sh.mut existed exited 143 and left git status clean and no temp dir.
Rerun 2026-11-26 with headless Chromium, once normally and once with port 8811 held by another process: both printed the unbound 'Illegal invocation' TypeError and bound 'resolved', exit 0.

resolution: The three repro scripts are portable and clean up after themselves: badsha resolves its worktree argument to an absolute path and removes its sandbox on exit; the self-check mutation repro removes scripts/deploy.sh.mut and its temp dir through an EXIT trap (INT and TERM included); the CM-02 repro listens on an ephemeral port and closes the browser and server in a finally block. The lane brief, lane files, verification.md and e2e-env-patch.diff use <repo>, <scratchpad> and <chromium-executable> placeholders in place of /home/user, /tmp/claude-0 and /opt/pw-browsers paths, and MANIFEST.md byte counts match the edited files. Left as written: /tmp/wt-x in lanes/00-known-issues.md and the mktemp path in evidence/d1-tooling-deploy-badsha.txt, which are historical records of what ran and are outside the three path families the acceptance names.
